findings.note: SR 838, the State Assurance of Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Amendment, would amend the Georgia Constitution to say only citizens of the United States may vote and to require registered electors to present photographic identification before casting a ballot in any election. The text lists him among the sponsors ('Senators Dolezal of the 27th, Still of the 48th, Albers of the 56th, Echols of the 49th, Walker III of the 20th and others'); he is not the first-named sponsor. Date is the introduction date shown on the fastdemocracy page, which also shows the Senate lost the adoption vote 32-23 on 2026-03-06 (floor vote is linked separately).
